messages.subject: CmdStan v2.12.0 released!
parts:
Hi all,

CmdStan v2.12.0 has been released. I tagged it on GitHub, updated the release on GitHub (https://github.com/stan-dev/cmdstan/releases/tag/v2.12.0), and update the website.

In the documentation part of the website, I have both the v2.11.0 and v2.12.0 manuals linked.


Daniel
